# Ampplify Academy

> Ampplify Academy (spelled with two p's, not "Amplify") is the trading name of Rakiza Company LTD, a UK company (registered in England & Wales; 128 City Road, London EC1V 2NX). It offers Amazon seller training and Amazon account management services for sellers on all Amazon marketplaces, including the USA, UK, India, Saudi Arabia (KSA) and the UAE.

Ampplify Academy is not affiliated with other organisations named "Amplify Academy".

## Main pages
- [Home / Amazon selling course](https://ampplifyacademy.com/): step-by-step Amazon FBA, FBM and private label course
- [About us](https://ampplifyacademy.com/about.html): who we are, company details, how we work
- [Services](https://ampplifyacademy.com/services.html): account setup and reactivation, listing and A+ content, PPC, Brand Registry, UK Ltd formation, trade mark support
- [Monthly plans](https://ampplifyacademy.com/monthly.html): Performance Management, Complete Management, FBA Upgrade and Post-Reinstatement Support, priced per month in SAR
- [Guide: Amazon FBA vs FBM](https://ampplifyacademy.com/amazon-fba-vs-fbm.html)
- [Guide: Give Access Safely](https://ampplifyacademy.com/give-access-to-service-provider.html)
- [Guide: Selling on Amazon KSA and UAE](https://ampplifyacademy.com/selling-on-amazon-saudi-arabia-uae.html)
- [Guide: Open a Seller Account](https://ampplifyacademy.com/how-to-open-amazon-seller-account.html)
